name: New Jersey Data Privacy Act
description: New Jersey's comprehensive consumer privacy law. SB/S332 (2024), signed January 16 2024, effective January 15 2025.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of New Jersey (nj.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of New Jersey (nj.gov).
